Reference List for the ASTEROID TAXONOMY bundle
===============================================

Barucci, M.A., M.T. Capria, A. Coradini,
        and M. Fulchignoni, Classification of asteroids using G-mode analysis,
        Icarus 72, 304- 324, 1987.

Bell, J.F., P.D. Owensby, B.R. Hawke,   
        and M.J. Gaffey, The 52-color asteroid survey: Final results and      
        interpretation, (abstract) Lunar Planet Sci. Conf. XIX, 57,1988.

Bowell, E., T. Gehrels, and B. Zellner, 
        Magnitudes, colors, types, and adopted diameters of the asteroids, In 
        'Asteroids', T. Gehrels, Editor, The University of Arizona Press,     
        Tucson, pp. 1108-1129, 1979.

Bus, S.J. and R.P. Binzel, Phase II of  
        the small main-belt asteroid spectroscopic survey: A feature-based    
        taxonomy, Icarus 158, 146- 177, 2002.

Chapman, C.R. and M.J. Gaffey,          
        Reflectance spectra for 277 asteroids, Asteroids, Univ. of Arizona    
        Press, T. Gehrels, ed., 655- 687, 1979.

DeMeo, F., R.P. Binzel, S.M. Slivan, and
        S.J. Bus, An extension of the Bus asteroid taxonomy into the          
        near-infrared, Icarus 202, 160-180, 2009.

Howell, E.S., E. Merenyi, and L.A.      
        Lebofsky, Classification of asteroid spectra using a neural network.  
        Journal of Geophysical Results 99, 10847-10865, 1994.

Lazzaro, D., C.A. Angeli, J.M. Carvano, 
        T. Mothe-Diniz, R. Duffard, and M. Florczak, S3OS2: The visible       
        spectroscopic survey of 820 asteroids, Icarus 172, 179-220, 2004.

Mueller, B.E.A., D.J. Tholen, W.K.      
        Hartmann, and D.P. Cruikshank, Extraordinary colors of asteroidal     
        object (5145) 1992 AD. Icarus 97, 150, 1992.

Tedesco, E.F., Asteroid magnitudes, UBV 
        colors, and IRAS albedos and diameters, In 'Asteroids II', R.P.       
        Binzel, T. Gehrels, and M.S. Matthews, Editors, The University of     
        Arizona Press, Tucson, pp. 1090-1138, 1989.

Tedesco, E.F., J.G. Williams, D.L.      
        Matson, G.J. Veeder, J.C. Gradie, and L.A. Lebofsky, A Three-Parameter
        Asteroid Taxonomy, Astron. J. 97, 580-606, 1989.

Tholen, D.J., Asteroid Taxonomic        
        Classifcations, In 'Asteroids II' (R.P. Binzel, T. Gehrels, M.S.      
        Matthews, Eds.), pp. 1139-1150, University of Arizona Press, Tucson,  
        1989.

Tholen, D.J., Asteroid Taxonomy from    
        Cluster Analysis of Photometry, Ph.D. dissertation, University of     
        Arizona, 1984.

Xu, S., R.P. Binzel, T.H. Burbine, and  
        S.J. Bus, Small Main-belt Asteroid Spectroscopic Survey: Initial      
        results, Icarus, 115, 1-35, 1995.

Zellner, B., D.J. Tholen, and E.F.      
        Tedesco, The Eight-Color Asteroid Survey: Results for 589 Minor       
        Planets, Icarus 61, 355-416, 1985.
